FN-RPK8MNN-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 83
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Tracy Estes
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/18/2024
House Bill 83as introduced could increase the obligations of any local boards of education that
votes to increase board member compensation above $600 per month, under current law, to no
more than $900 per month as authorized pursuant to the provisions of this bill, by an amount
increase dependent on: (1) the compensation increase from $600 to $900 per month approved by
the board; and (2) the number of board members affected.
This bill would also: (1) prohibit a member of a local board of education not in compliance with
continuing education and training requirements from receiving compensation, until the member
is in compliance; and (2) require all compensation not received by a board member for
noncompliance to remain in escrow until the member becomes compliant, or to revert back to
the local boards of education once the individual is no longer a member of the board.
